verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework. A framework could plausibly ship API-key or token scaffolding, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows any way to issue scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The AGENTS.md 'safe edit boundaries' guidance is an adjacent, documentation-level control rather than credential scoping, and the openapi.json probe shows only that a spec file exists, not any credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
